name: Click Kick
description: The kick at its shortest and highest, mostly click.

name: High Kick
description: The kick tuned up, nearer a tom.

name: Low Kick
description: The kick tuned down.

name: Machine Kick
description: The smaller machine's kick as it has it: a short, round thump with a click on top.

name: Pillow Kick
description: The kick soft and long, no click.

name: Ringing Thump
description: The kick left to ring, deeper and longer.

name: Short Thump
description: The kick cut short: a dry thump for busy patterns.

name: Soft Kick
description: The kick with its click rounded off.

name: Loose Hat
description: The closed hat let ring.

name: Machine Closed Hat
description: The smaller machine's closed hat as it has it: a quick, bright tick.

name: Tick Hat
description: The closed hat at its shortest.

name: Dark Ride
description: The cymbal's slow band alone, long, nearer a ride's swell.

name: Machine Cymbal
description: The smaller machine's cymbal as it has it: a bright splash over a slower ring.

name: Low Bongo
description: The high tom tuned up and cut short, nearer a bongo.

name: Machine High Tom
description: The smaller machine's high tom as it has it.

name: Rack Tom
description: The high tom tuned up and left to ring.

name: Short High Tom
description: The high tom cut short.

name: Deep Tom
description: The low tom at the bottom of its tune.

name: Floor Tom
description: The low tom tuned down and left to ring.

name: Machine Low Tom
description: The smaller machine's low tom as it has it: it starts high and falls to its pitch.

name: Short Low Tom
description: The low tom cut short.

name: Long Open Hat
description: The open hat at its longest.

name: Machine Open Hat
description: The smaller machine's open hat as it has it: a hiss that holds and stops.

name: Short Open Hat
description: The open hat cut short.

name: Body Snare
description: The snare mostly shell, its noise turned down.

name: High Snare
description: The snare tuned up, nearer a piccolo.

name: Low Snare
description: The snare tuned down.

name: Machine Snare
description: The smaller machine's snare as it has it: a light shell and a short burst of noise.

name: Noise Burst
description: The snare almost all noise, ringing long.

name: Snappy Snare
description: The snare with its noise brought up.

name: Tight Snare
description: The snare's noise cut short.

name: Washy Snare
description: The snare's noise left to hiss on.
